The '''Subterrel sector''' was a [[sector]] located in [[the galaxy]]'s [[Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Polis Massa system]], which was home to a [[planet]] of [[Polis Massa|the same name]] until the world<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars" /> was [[Polis Massa cataclysm|destroyed]] by ancient [[superweapon]]s,<ref name="Jedi Fallen Order">''[[Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order]]''</ref> leaving behind only an [[asteroid field]].<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars" />
